primitives.name: Kickoff Positioning
primitives.verbatim_quote: 140 SPALDING'S OFFICIAL FOOT BALL GUIDE. RULE XXVII. RULE VII.—KICK-OFF. SEcTioN 1—Team entitled to kick-off. SECTioN
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a two-team zero-sum game with alternating possession and fixed rules for ball placement at kickoff.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when the kicking team violates the five-center-line constraint, resulting in an automatic foul.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a discrete state-transition system where the current state is the ball location relative to goal lines, and actions are player movements constrained by rule boundaries.
layer2.telemetry: Observed as the spatial distribution of offensive linemen at the kickoff point, measured in yards from the kicking team's goal line.

primitives.name: Scrimmage Line Constraints
primitives.verbatim_quote: SEcTioN 4—Five center men to be on line. SECTioN 5—One player in motion. RULE X.—POSITION OF
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a fixed formation geometry where exactly five offensive linemen must align parallel to the line of scrimmage, with one additional player permitted to move.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The regime breaks down when more than five players are simultaneously on the line, causing a foul and loss of down.

layer2.mapping: Represents a geometric hyperplane constraint in the n-dimensional space of player positions, defining a legal configuration manifold for the offensive formation.
layer2.telemetry: Measured by counting the number of offensive players whose shoulders are aligned within a specified tolerance of the nominal line of scrimmage.

primitives.name: Post-Touchdown Kick Positioning
primitives.verbatim_quote: in possession of the ball to cross restraining line. RULE XII.—POSITION OF PLAYERS ON FREE-KICK AFTER
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a specialized free-kick scenario following a touchdown, with specific restrictions on player positioning near the restraining line.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when any player crosses the restraining line before the ball is legally kicked, resulting in a penalty yardage addition.

layer2.mapping: Derives from the general free-kick positioning kernel but adds a hard boundary condition at the restraining line, creating a semi-infinite state space for the kicker.
layer2.telemetry: Captured as the minimum signed distance between the kicker's foot and the restraining line at the moment of contact, with negative values indicating illegal advance.

primitives.name: Fair Catch Free Kick
primitives.verbatim_quote: (OTHER THAN FAIR CATCH FROM PUNT-OUT). SECTION 1-Kicker. SEctioN 2—No player in possession of the ball
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a free-kick situation arising from a fair catch, with the kicker restricted from being in possession of the ball prior to the kick.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The regime fails if the designated kicker has the ball in their hands at the instant of the kick, leading to a dead-ball foul.

layer2.mapping: Encodes a logical predicate over the ball's possession history within a bounded time window preceding the kick, transitioning the game state based on this memory-dependent condition.
layer2.telemetry: Derived from tracking the ball's possession chain; a binary indicator variable that flags true whenever the kicker holds the ball immediately before the free-kick motion.
